published: Prime Minister Philip Edward DAVIS (since 17 September 2021)
process: the monarchy is hereditary; governor-general appointed by the monarch on the advice of the prime minister; following legislative elections, the governor-general appoints the leader of the majority party or majority coalition as prime minister; the prime minister recommends the deputy prime minister
governmentType: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
cabinet: Cabinet appointed by governor-general on recommendation of prime minister
